description: THE STREAM -- perception spends a BOUNDED budget, ordered by SALIENCE x SCALE. Vision is not delivered all-at-once and uniform: it is STREAMED -- coarse-to-fine by scale (large low-frequency structure resolves first; detail refines on the residual, order-N), allocated by salience (the bounded refinement budget is spent on the largest-residual region first), and PREEMPTIBLE (a maximally-salient 'spear' captures the budget and the rest degrades to the top-down render -- tunnel vision). ONE water-filling rule (stream_resolve_salient) over a residual-mass region field: the salience order is a pure Argmax, the budget is a Scene attr counted up as graph data, and coarse-first / budget-allocation / preemption all fall OUT with ZERO magic numbers (no preemption threshold -- §13). NO new Rust: reuses the Argmax/Plus/Neighbours/Filter DSL and the run_rules fixpoint. Composes the just-landed bidirectional loop: salience = the render-vs-input residual mass. In-frame/integer only (the frame/continuum invariant). Flag-gated on StreamParams.stream, OFF by default (§9). See VISION_STREAM_PREREG.md.

microtheory.label: the visual stream: a salience-ordered bounded budget

rules.name: stream_resolve_salient
rules.comment: THE STREAM (the one contribution rule). Per run_rules pass, resolve the single highest-residual (Argmax) unresolved region of the scene while the budget is not spent, record its stream position (order = spent), and count the budget up (spent += 1). Exactly one region -- the unique Argmax winner (deterministic first-encountered tiebreak, the qf_frontier_goal idiom) -- passes the where per pass, so the budget advances by one and the regions stream in DESCENDING residual order until spent==budget or no unresolved positive-residual region remains. Coarse-first (a large/coarse structure carries more residual MASS -> wins first), budget-allocation (water-filling to the salient region), and preemption/tunnel (a majority-mass 'spear' drains the budget -> periphery left at render grain) are ALL consequences of this one rule -- there is NO preemption threshold (§13: preemption falls OUT of the argmax). Flag-gated on StreamParams.stream>0.5, OFF by default (§9): inert without it.
